title: Duplex & Speed
description: Understand full vs half duplex and interface speed settings.
scenario: Understand full vs half duplex and interface speed settings.

concepts.title: Duplex Modes
concepts.body: Half-duplex: devices take turns transmitting (like a hub). Full-duplex: devices can send and receive simultaneously (like a switch).
concepts.code:
Half-duplex: 1 direction at a time
Full-duplex:  both directions at once

concepts.title: Speed
concepts.body: Speed is the data rate: 10, 100, 1000 Mbps. Auto-negotiation is the default.

concepts.title: Duplex Mismatch
concepts.body: If one side is full and the other is half, you get late collisions and poor performance.
concepts.code:
Side A: full-duplex
Side B: half-duplex → collisions!
